summary_objective:

Prefers a command line interface environment & big fan of Vim, Lisp-like macro languages, and customize all the most optimal environment. experience.title: Founding Member & Site Reliability Engineer & Infrastructure Team Lead
description: Everything that matters.
Designed an provisioned the entire infrastructure on the AWS cloud to meet security compliance and acquire a business license for financial service in Korea.
Continuously improved the infrastructure architecture since launching the service. (currently 3.6 million users)

Established a declarative service for declarative management of infrastructures and service deployments, enabling operational efficiency and consistency. Over 90% of AWS resources are all managed through standardizing Terraform modules. All add-ons and service workloads on the Kubernetes cluster were managed on a GitOps basis with Kustomize and ArgoCD.
Saved over 50% of the overall AWS costs by conducting a quarterly purchasing strategy for RI (Reserved Instance) and SP (Savings Plan) and by introducing Graviton instances.

Established a core architecture for regulating outbound SNS traffic in multi-account and multi-VPC environments utilizing AWS Route53 DNS firewall and Lambda to significantly increased the level of security confidence in the financial sector's segregated environment.

Introduced Okta employee identity solution in the company, establishing security policies and configuring SSO integration with over 20 enterprise tools including AWS, GitHub, Slack, Google Workspace. Set up a Hub and Spoke architecture, enabling a collaborative account structure with the parent company, Foreign Market.

experience.title: Founding Member & Director of Infrastructure Division

Wrote Terraform module to easily provision ECS clusters on AWS EC2 instances.

Implemented broker server instances connecting with KakaoBizTalk for email, SMS, KakaoTalk (Push Notification). Developed a reverse proxy framework to easily build Kafka consumer microservice with common features including retry on failure, DLQ (Dead Letter Queue), event routing and more.
Introduced Elastic APM to help distributed tracing, trouble-shooting and performance testing in MSA.
